entries.title: Unify agent profile content
entries.rationale: Accepted as a profile-truthfulness and identity-lifecycle change, queued because it changes owner-authenticated archive content, active persona selection, runtime disclosure, and profile entry-point parity.
security_reasons: owner-authenticated identity archive requests now carry persona linkage
active persona selection changes which managed instance receives profile actions
synthetic runtime/configuration data is removed to prevent false disclosure
profile entry points must not expose actions or runtime data from the wrong agent

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated identity/profile authorization review, archive-event tests, runtime disclosure tests, dependency/egress screening, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and desktop/Tauri gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, owner-authenticated archive changes, profile parity tests, runtime disclosure tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
